chikungunya-costa-rica.title: Level 2 - Chikungunya in Costa Rica
chikungunya-costa-rica.summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in northwest Costa Rica. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

chikungunya-french-guiana.title: Level 2 - Chikungunya in French Guiana
chikungunya-french-guiana.summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in French Guiana. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

chikungunya-nicaragua.title: Level 2 - Chikungunya in Nicaragua
chikungunya-nicaragua.summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Nicaragua. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

dengue-global.title: Level 1 - Global Dengue
dengue-global.summary: Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites.

diphtheria-haiti.title: Level 1 - Diphtheria in Haiti
diphtheria-haiti.summary: There is an outbreak of diphtheria in Haiti. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.

diphtheria-sub-saharan-africa.title: Level 1 - Diphtheria in Sub-Saharan Africa
diphtheria-sub-saharan-africa.summary: There are outbreaks of diphtheria in several countries in Africa. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.

ebola-democratic-republic-of-the-congo.title: Level 3 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
ebola-democratic-republic-of-the-congo.disease_place: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
ebola-democratic-republic-of-the-congo.summary: CDC recommends avoiding nonessential travel to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.

ebola-drc-provinces.title: Level 4 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
ebola-drc-provinces.disease_place: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
ebola-drc-provinces.summary: CDC recommends avoiding all travel to Ituri and Nord-Kivu (North-Kivu) provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak unless traveling for humanitarian aid or emergency response.

ebola-drc-uganda.title: Level 2 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
ebola-drc-uganda.disease_place: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
ebola-drc-uganda.summary: CDC recommends practicing enhanced precautions for travel to Uganda or to provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) not affected by the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.

ebola-kenya.title: Level 1 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya
ebola-kenya.disease_place: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya
ebola-kenya.summary: The Kenyan Ministry of Health has confirmed an imported case, as well as other linked cases, of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in Nairobi, Kenya.

global-polio.title: Level 2 - Global Polio
global-polio.summary: Some international destinations have circulating poliovirus. Before any international travel, make sure you are up to date on your polio vaccines.

hepatitis-a-canada.title: Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Canada
hepatitis-a-canada.summary: Manitoba, Canada is currently experiencing a hepatitis A virus (HAV) outbreak. HAV is contagious and spreads through close person-to-person contact and by eating contaminated food or drink.

hepatitis-a-costa-rica.title: Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Costa Rica
hepatitis-a-costa-rica.summary: There is an outbreak of hepatitis A (HAV) in Costa Rica. Most cases have been reported in San José province.

malaria-mayotte.title: Level 2 - Malaria in Mayotte
malaria-mayotte.summary: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Mayotte. Malaria is spread by the bite of infected mosquitoes.

malaria-yemen.title: Level 2 - Malaria in Yemen
malaria-yemen.summary: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Yemen, including in areas that were previously considered low-risk.

measles-globe.title: Level 1 - Global Measles
measles-globe.summary: Measles cases are rising in many countries around the world. All international travelers should be fully vaccinated against measles with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine, according to CDC's measles vaccination recommendations for international travel.

meningococcal-drc.title: Level 2 - Meningococcal Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
meningococcal-drc.disease_place: Meningococcal Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
meningococcal-drc.summary: There is an outbreak of meningococcal disease in the Mangembo Health Zone of Kongo Central Province. The best way to protect yourself is to get meningococcal vaccination.

paratyphoid-fever-yemen.title: Level 1 - Paratyphoid Fever in Yemen
paratyphoid-fever-yemen.summary: Cases of paratyphoid fever are being reported in returning travelers from Yemen. You can prevent paratyphoid fever by practicing safe eating and drinking habits.

rmsf-mexico.title: Level 1 - Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mexico
rmsf-mexico.disease_place: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mexico
rmsf-mexico.summary: Illness and death due to Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) have been reported in the northern region of Mexico along the U.S. border, particularly in Baja California, Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, and Nuevo León.

yellow-fever-colombia.title: Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Colombia
yellow-fever-colombia.summary: An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.

yellow-fever-ghana.title: Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, and Ghana
yellow-fever-ghana.disease_place: Yellow Fever in Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, and Ghana
yellow-fever-ghana.summary: There are outbreaks of yellow fever in the Nando Region of Burkina Faso, Bounkani Region of Côte d’Ivoire, and the Upper West Region of Ghana. Travelers to these regions should take steps to prevent yellow fever by getting vaccinated at least 10 days before travel and taking steps to prevent mosquito bites.

zika-indonesia.title: Level 2 - Zika in Indonesia
zika-indonesia.summary: Cases of Zika are being reported in returning travelers from Bali, Indonesia. All travelers to Bali should take steps to prevent mosquito bites and sexual transmission of Zika virus during and after travel.
